name: Absurd News Slides
description: Today's headlines, reported accurately and then punctured — as a presentable slide deck.

config.userPrompt:
From the RSS below, pick the THREE stories that are both NEWSWORTHY and can carry
irony — institutions behaving absurdly, industries contradicting themselves, official
nonsense. EXCLUDE anything whose subject is a death, an injury, a missing person, a crime
against a person, or an obituary: those are reported straight or not at all, never joked
about. Return ONLY the article URLs, one per line, nothing else.

{{INPUT}}

Write a SLIDE DECK of today's absurd news: real stories, reported accurately, then punctured.

RULES
- Cover the THREE stories below, in order, one slide each.
- THE NEWS MUST STILL LAND. Every slide's bullets carry the actual facts FIRST — the number, the place, the decision — and the wry line comes last. A reader who only sees the slides should come away genuinely informed. A joke that replaces a fact has failed.
- Aim the irony at institutions, industries and absurd situations. NEVER at individuals suffering, NEVER at anyone's death or injury.
- Never invent a number, a name or a quote. If the source does not support it, leave it out.
- Bullets are cues, not sentences: six words is comfortable, ten is the ceiling. At most four per slide.
- The paragraph under the bullets becomes the speaker notes — that is where the full sentences and the source detail go.

OUTPUT EXACTLY THIS MARKDOWN SHAPE AND NOTHING ELSE:

# Absurd News

## <headline as a claim, five words or fewer>
- <fact>
- <fact>
- <the wry line>
<One or two sentences of plain prose: what actually happened, and where it was reported. This becomes the speaker notes.>

## <second story headline>
- <fact>
- <fact>
- <the wry line>
<notes paragraph>

## <third story headline>
- <fact>
- <fact>
- <the wry line>
<notes paragraph>

SOURCE MATERIAL:
{{INPUT}}
